prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one new high-fidelity flat UI comparison board for the existing DooKnow whiteboard canvas context menu. Image 1 is authoritative existing UI content; image 2 supplies ONLY flat palette/typographic hierarchy, never copy its desktop rail, title or notebook fields. Two independent narrow local viewport specimens side by side, left 390px wide and right 320px wide, each representing height844. Small external A / B labels allowed outside the product. Neutral white canvas, generous outside whitespace, absolutely no device/browser chrome or descriptive paragraphs. Within each white canvas place a bounded context menu near the lower-right anchor, fully inside the visible viewport. Preserve exactly seven existing text-only rows, in this exact order: "粘贴", separator, "全部选中", separator, "Toggle grid", "吸附至对象", "禅模式", "查看模式", "Canvas & Shape properties". Last label must remain readable and wrap within320 if needed, with enough row height; no truncated button. This is the empty canvas state: no drawn shapes, selected objects, copy/export/group/delete items, statistics panel or invented long-press control. Do not add submenu arrows, checkboxes, icons, close button, search or Done/Cancel. This menu is dismissed through its existing behavior, not an added action. Keep style calm and compact: white paper, #272b3a text, #657084 secondary, #e6e9f1 one-pixel borders, #4566c6 accents if relevant, 8px corner radius, very restrained shadow. Exact labels may be mixed Chinese/English as above. Crisp readable14px-equivalent type, clear hit rows, no gradients/textures/3D. Local component comparison only; no owner/private navigation or extra app toolbar. These are design specimens, not a claim that touch/clipboard/statistics behavior was verified.
